verdict.rationale: cubic is a SaaS code-review platform, so registrable outbound webhooks are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents only pull-style APIs (Analytics and Members APIs), an MCP server, a CLI and tool integrations (Jira, Linear, Notion, Datadog). Nothing shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer could receive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
